load_path: North: lid countersink -> M2x6 screw -> captured nut -> pocket roof -> OD8 pillar -> tray floor. South: lid countersink -> M2x10 screw -> existing Main H2/H3 boss threads -> tray floor. Downward south load passes through a removable POM spacer and original Main washer/PCB/boss stack.
screw: 2 x ISO 10642 M2x6 north + 2 x M2x10 south; minor shaft1.6, head OD4 x1.0. South pair replaces original Main H2/H3 M2x6; other Main screw unchanged.
nuts: 2 x ISO 4032 M2, AF4, t1.6, captured without adhesive; south threads engage existing printed Main bosses.
qualification_limit: Local strip and retention checks do not qualify the full perforated/pocketed panel, printed layer strength or 10N deflection of the unsupported centre. The colliding assembly cannot certify service/inversion. No gate5 PASS.

cost_USD.basis: Planning only: 1.0–2.0 shop hours at $60–120/h; stock/fixture/finish $25–50. Batch amortizes setup. Not supplier quotations; no order proposed.

material: 6061-T6 aluminium, machined from supported stock to 1.50 nominal / 0.25 GH skin. 5052-H32 Wing stock is a comparison, not an automatic pocket machining qualification.

sources.purpose: 6061-T6 material context; E69GPa and 240MPa yield are explicit conservative study inputs, not lot certificates.
Wing-style 5052 comparison: typical E70.3GPa/yield193MPa; supplier cautions typical data is not for design.
